title: Achala Swarm — Agentic AI Orchestration Platform
seo_title: Achala Swarm — Agentic AI Orchestration Platform | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Achala Swarm, our Agentic AI Orchestration Platform, coordinates large agent fleets with queues, budgets, human checkpoints and full audit.

blocks.x: Hundreds of AI agents, working as one measurable team. Achala Swarm orchestrates agent fleets with work queues, spend budgets and human checkpoints, so automation scales without losing control.

Achala Swarm is our Agentic AI Orchestration Platform. It takes the agents you have validated and runs them as a coordinated workforce: tasks are queued, prioritized, budgeted and monitored. Where a decision matters too much to automate, the platform routes it to a person instead of guessing.
Named modules, each with a clear job:

items: Every agent versioned, with its permissions and test record
Task assignment with priorities, retries and deadlines
Per-team and per-workflow model spend, with alerts
Escalation paths for the decisions that keep a person in the loop

blocks.title: Achala Swarm — module topology
blocks.note: Modules are the platform's named components; trust lane is what the audit reads.

blocks.x: Agents act on your systems, so their actions need the same governance as people's:

items: Agents get scoped credentials, rotated and logged
Every agent action recorded with its inputs and authorizations
Hard ceilings per workflow, enforced at runtime
Any agent or fleet can be stopped in one action

blocks.x: Achala Swarm runs document-heavy operations in banking, insurance, healthcare and shared-service centers, anywhere a validated task repeats often enough to automate and matters enough to govern.
Works with your existing agent frameworks and model providers through adapters. Orchestrated work lands back in your systems of record via versioned, contract-tested connectors.
Bring one process to a briefing. We will show the agent fleet, the queues and the human checkpoints it would run with.
